prompt: A drowned dock laborer risen as a horror, standing full-length and facing the viewer, gaunt and far too tall, shoulders hunched forward, arms hanging past the knees ending in long bony fingers. Its whole head is bound in a waterlogged burlap sack cinched at the neck with rope; the cloth is blank and smooth, with dark seawater stains seeping down from where a face would be. Grey-blue drowned skin, ribs showing through the torn wet rags of a fisherman's coat, kelp and frayed rope tangled around the legs, bare blackened feet. Realistic oil-painted figure with smooth tonal shading and no outlines, lit dimly from the lower front by warm lantern light, deep shadow above. Whole figure in frame with margin all round. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
